name: Northwind Retail
description: A full e-commerce rebuild for a regional retail chain, moving them off a legacy platform onto a fast, modern storefront.
problem: Legacy platform couldn't handle catalog growth and checkout was losing 40% of carts.
solution: Rebuilt on a modern headless stack with a streamlined one-page checkout and real-time inventory sync.

name: Vantage Copilot
description: A custom AI support copilot trained on the client's help docs and ticket history, embedded directly in their product.
problem: Support volume was growing faster than the team could hire.
solution: Trained a copilot on existing help docs and ticket history, embedded directly in the product.

name: Orbit Fitness
description: A cross-platform fitness app with workout tracking, social challenges, and wearable integration.
problem: Needed iOS and Android live simultaneously for a launch event.
solution: Single React Native codebase with native wearable integrations shipped both platforms together.

name: Solace Studio
description: A complete brand identity and visual system for a wellness studio expanding to five new locations.
problem: Five new studio locations opening with no shared visual identity.
solution: Full brand system — logo, guidelines, and templates — that scales across every location.

name: Ledger Finance
description: A marketing site and investor portal for a fintech startup ahead of their Series A raise.
problem: Marketing site undersold the product to investors and enterprise leads.
solution: Fast, credibility-focused rebuild with a dedicated investor portal.

name: Pulse Analytics
description: A predictive analytics dashboard that forecasts inventory needs for a multi-warehouse logistics client.
problem: Twelve warehouses were manually forecasting inventory, causing stockouts.
solution: A predictive model trained on historical demand data, surfaced through a live dashboard.

name: Meridian ERP
description: A custom internal operations system replacing six disconnected spreadsheets for a manufacturing client.
problem: Leadership had zero real-time visibility across six spreadsheets.
solution: One custom internal system with live reporting and role-based access.

name: Aperture Reel
description: A season of short-form social content for a consumer brand's product launch campaign.
problem: Needed scroll-stopping short-form content across Instagram and TikTok, fast.
solution: A tight production pipeline delivering 32 edited videos in under six weeks.
